mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, increasing the present value of expected returns and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of macro easing periods despite negative FEDFUNDS signals, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a flight to quality as investors sell high-yield bonds, compressing their prices and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of tightening episodes despite high FEDFUNDS signals, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs signals a strengthening labor market, prompting firms to increase investment in productive capacity and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of labor expansion episodes despite rising PAYEMS, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 150,000 jobs triggers a risk-off spiral as investors anticipate layoffs, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of contraction episodes despite falling PAYEMS, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) above 1,000K units signals resilient consumer demand, prompting firms to raise prices and expand capacity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of strong-demand episodes despite rising HOUST, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index) signals supply-side weakness, prompting firms to cut investment and reduce capacity, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of contraction episodes despite falling INDPRO, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in retail sales (HOUST) below 900K units triggers a risk-off spiral as investors anticipate weak demand, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of weak-demand episodes despite falling HOUST, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in CPIAUCSL inflation above 2.5% triggers a preemptive rate hike by the Fed, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of high-inflation episodes despite rising CPIAUCSL, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year window.
